usage: xo symbols [--dir=DIR] [--pub] [--doc] [--limit=N] [--json] [DIR | FILE.xo | NAME]
       xo symbols --file=FILE.xo | --module=PATH [--pub] [--doc] [NAME]

The declarations of one directory's own files, private ones too; --pub
lists the exported surface only. At a root with no .xo files of its
own, the directories below that have them are named. --file (or a .xo
argument) lists one file's; --module one module's by its import path,
std and runtime ones too (std/json, native/llrt/pool). A NAME that is
not a directory keeps the declarations whose name contains it, or
matches it with `*` for any run (`check_*`). Text: `kind name
file:line  signature` a line (a signature's first line); --doc adds
each doc comment. --limit=N shows the first N and says how many there
are (JSON "total").

Output is compact text, a record a line, so grep and head cut it
(decision 0386); --json is the same answer as JSON, broken over lines
with a flat record (a reference, a symbol) on one line. Exit status: 0
with an answer, 1 for no match, 2 for a usage error.
